title: Forza Horizon 6 hits PS5 on January 26, 2027 🏎️
subject: forzahorizon6
description:
Will you play it on PS5 or are you already racing in Japan? 👇

Playground Games confirmed on October 8, 2026 that Forza Horizon 6 launches on PS5 on January 26, 2027, after previously saying the PS5 version was due in 2026. Premium Edition owners get 5 days of early access from January 21, the same day the first expansion arrives on all platforms. Pre-orders are live, with cross-play and cross-save with Xbox and Steam.

Sources: Forza.net (Oct 8, 2026), VGC (Oct 8, 2026), Insider Gaming (Oct 7, 2026), Forza.net (May 19 launch announcement)
Game footage © Microsoft / Playground Games.
